description: ONLY on request, after character_scene. Animates scene.png into a silent looping idle clip: Veo 3.1 Fast by default, one 8 s piece that ends on its first frame; Kling makes it from two pieces (see loop), billed as two clips. Before the first video of a scene, a vision model reads what moves in scene.png (about $0.004, kept until the scene is redrawn), unless motion is given. dry_run returns the exact prompt and the price without making the video. Paid: tell the user the price from character_next and wait for a yes.

dry_run.description: Return the exact prompt, the pieces and the price without making the video.

loop.description: frame (Veo default): one piece whose last frame = first frame; Veo keeps the character moving, Kling freezes everything. chain (Kling default): a free piece from scene.png, then a piece from its last frame back to scene.png, joined without the duplicated frames; two clips of about seconds/2 each, and the second can drift. crossfade: the last second is blended into the first; the seam shows. off: a plain clip. Default frame when start is given.

model.description: Default from models.json (veo). veo: Veo 3.1 Fast (4/6/8 s; prompt up to 20 000 characters) · kling: Kling O1 (3–10 s; prompt up to 2500) · kling3: Kling 3.0 (3–15 s; also told what must never appear). Veo and Kling 3.0 are also told what must never appear. All silent.

motion.description: What in scene.png moves and how, if you can see the picture: one short line per thing, only what is visible, each 'repeats' (turns, sways, flickers) or 'stays still' (could only change one way). Replaces the vision model's reading, free.

notes.description: Corrections for this take, in plain words (e.g. 'his height must read against the ceiling', 'hands stay off the barometer', 'no smoke'). They go first as binding rules and win over the default prompt. Use this to fix a result instead of rewriting the whole prompt.

prompt.description: Replaces the default prompt. Name nothing that isn't in the scene, and nothing as a ban: the model draws whatever is named. Breathing, blinking, a habitual gesture; things in the scene move at a steady speed in whole cycles, never backward; the same person throughout; static camera.

seconds.description: About how long the loop runs; default 10. A chain splits it into two pieces, each rounded into the model's range (Kling O1 3–10 s, 5 or 10 without an end frame; Kling 3.0 3–15; Veo 4, 6 or 8), so 10 is 5 + 5 s on Kling O1. dry_run shows the pieces and the price.

start.description: A first frame instead of scene.png, for one piece (loop frame, crossfade or off): a file name in the character's assets folder or an https URL. With loop frame the piece ends on scene.png.

name: character_video
title: Looping idle video
